`GET /invoices/<id>` in `src/api/invoices.py` now returns a 404 when the invoice isn't found. I haven't run it or any tests.

The response is built with `problem(404, "Invoice not found", ...)` from `src/api/errors.py`, so it's an RFC 7807 problem+json body, as the project convention requires. Before this change, a missing id made the handler call `.__dict__` on `None`, which raised an error.

I wrote the import as `from src.api.errors import problem`. I didn't check how other modules in the repo import it, so the path may need adjusting.
